Finished third behind Overtime Bonus in his local debut on Oct 2 earning an 88 speed figure while rallying in the 4-to-5 path. Entitled to make a solid step forward second-out for Matthew Sims with Francisco Arrieta returning to the irons.

contenders.handicapper_notes: World-class dirt titan enters in peak physical form following an authoritative romp in the Grade 1 Jockey Club Gold Cup with a 118 Beyer-par speed figure. The scratch of chief international rival Magnitude leaves him with an ideal tactical stalk-and-pounce trip behind projected pacesetters Knightsbridge and Napoleon Solo. Relishes 10 furlongs and possesses an unmatched sustained turn of foot.

Dominant Grade 1 Whitney winner returns to his best distance of 1 1/4 miles, where he previously captured both the Kentucky Derby, Belmont, and Travers in devastating fashion. Hall of Fame trainer Bill Mott excels in championship dirt routes and regular pilot Junior Alvarado will draft comfortably along the inside rail before utilizing Keeneland long 1,236-foot primary stretch.

Stretched out to 10 furlongs in the Pacific Classic at Del Mar and ran the field off their feet with a scintillating 6 1/4-length gate-to-wire clinic. Benefited enormously by the scratch of Magnitude, leaving him to prompt or dictate moderate splits from the outside alongside Napoleon Solo under Luis Saez.

Classic winner at 10 furlongs who rallied stoutly to hit the board in the Travers behind Leading Change and Napoleon Solo. Possesses a formidable closing kick and gets Jose Ortiz back in the irons. Will appreciate the extended Keeneland stretch run to pick up tiring frontrunners late.

Preakness winner and runner-up in both the Haskell and Travers. With Magnitude scratched, he projects to break sharp from the outside post under John Velazquez and establish the early running. If allowed an uncontested opening half-mile, he represents the race primary danger horse to steal it on the engine.

Exits a sharp victory in the Grade 1 Pennsylvania Derby with a 108 speed figure. Steps up significantly in class against seasoned older horses and classic winners, but has tactical versatility to sit midpack and challenge for minor exotic placings.
